AI Companies Anthropic and Decart AI in Acquisition Talks

Artificial intelligence company Anthropic is reportedly in discussions to acquire startup Decart AI for approximately $6 billion. Decart AI's technology focuses on improving the efficiency of AI model training by optimizing chip performance, potentially reducing costs. The acquisition talks were reported by multiple news outlets, with one source confirming the negotiations.
